notify.craft_link_missing: That craft link points at an item that no longer exists.
notify.sign_in_to_save: Sign in to save this to your inventory.
notify.sign_in_to_inspect: Sign in to open this in game.
notify.copy_created: Editable copy created in your inventory.
notify.inspect_sent: Sent to your game client — CS2 will open the inspect view.
notify.loadout_copied: Copied {summary} into your inventory and equipped them on your own loadout.
notify.loadout_copy_empty: Nothing to copy — that loadout is empty.
notify.synced_partial: Synced with Steam — {summary}. Inventory too large to read fully.
notify.synced_no_changes: Synced with Steam — everything was already up to date.
notify.render_upload_failed: Render made locally, but saving it failed: {error}. Check backend deploy/mount.
notify.render_not_served: Render SAVED (backend OK) but /renders/ doesn't serve it back — frontend + backend pods aren't sharing the mount, or a cache is serving a stale 404.

cache.cleared_renders: Cleared card renders — each one re-bakes when it is next viewed.
cache.cleared_composites: Cleared paint composites — each skin re-composites once, then is shared again.
cache.heading: Assets on disk
cache.description: What this server has generated or extracted onto the models mount.
cache.section_extracted: Extracted from this server's CS2 install

rows.renders_hint: Baked item cards — cleared safely, re-render on view
rows.composites_hint: Shared skin textures — lets every viewer skip ~38MB of inputs per weapon
rows.paints_hint: Skin finishes — without these, skins render white
rows.images_hint: Flat catalog art for every item

server.key_reissued: New server key issued — the old key is now dead.

extract.started: Extraction job started — expect it to run for a long while.
extract.finished: Model extraction finished — 3D assets are live on the mount.

viewer.hint_place: Drag a sticker or the charm across the model to place it, and shift-drag a sticker to turn it.
viewer.hint_place_touch: Drag a sticker or the charm across the model to place it, and twist two fingers on a sticker to turn it.

controls.pause_clip: Pause the model's own inspect animation ({clip})
controls.play_clip: Play the model's own inspect animation ({clip})
controls.spin_hint_touch: Drag with one finger to rotate the model
controls.pan_hint_touch: Drag with two fingers to pan
controls.move_hint: Drag a sticker or charm to move it — zoom in for fine placement
controls.turn_hint_touch: Twist two fingers on a sticker to rotate it
controls.turn_hint: Shift-drag a sticker to rotate it

pattern.zoom_in: Showing {span} patterns — click to zoom in
pattern.zoom_full: Narrowest band — click for the full range
pattern.metric_measured: {metric}: measured over this finish's composited artwork
pattern.blink: Flip between the two on the model — the eye catches a change that blinks
pattern.find_weighted: Composite all {count} patterns once and rank them by {metric} — a few seconds, measured on the gun
pattern.find_hint: Composite all {count} patterns once and rank them by {metric}. Open the 3D view first and it can weight the answer by what you actually see.
pattern.pin_start: Hold this pattern, then move to another to see how they differ

actions.duplicate: Synced from Steam and read-only — craft your own copy of it

devhud.heading: Viewer settings
devhud.advanced_note: Rendering diagnostics. Several of these deliberately draw the model wrong so it can be measured — if something looks broken, reset.
devhud.reload_note: Read at load — reload to apply.

share.heading: Copy link
share.clipboard_failed: Couldn't reach the clipboard — copy from the address bar instead.

price.approx_note: No exact listing — this is the {note} one.
price.estimate: Rough estimate — {window} for {name}. Not a sale price.
